en-US.name: CalSync Family
en-US.description: CalSync Family lets your household read and create appointments on the shared family schedule.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: 1) Import this skill package. 2) Set the custom skill endpoint to https://edge-calsync.neonbutterfly.net/alexa with a trusted certificate. 3) Copy the generated skill ID into the Worker's ALEXA_ALLOWED_SKILL_IDS setting. 4) Set ENABLE_ALEXA=true and redeploy the Worker. 5) Test launch, next-up, list, create, cancel, and reschedule utterances in the Alexa developer console.
